ops.title: P2 parse-parity lane: fix codex-found parse-layer divergences (watchdisc triage)
ops.description: The watchdisc lane's codex adversarial review surfaced parse-layer parity divergences affecting ALL consumers (watch delegates to parse_entry; triaged out-of-scope there). Fix in a dedicated lane AFTER the queryfacts lane lands (both touch rust/crates/core/src/parse.rs — conflict risk while in flight). Items: (1) empty `usage:{}` drop semantics; (2) value type-filtering at parse (cwd:7, isSidechain:1 must preserve per trap #4); (3) tool-result non-str/list content handling; (4) empty toolDenialKind fallback; (5) huge-int/inf materialization behavior; (6) naive/leap-second timestamp parsing vs Python fromisoformat; (7) whitespace-driven interrupted/agent-injected flags (protocol.rs/filterspec boundary — check against Python str semantics per trap #1). Each: reproduce vs Python first, mirror exactly, pin in parse-level golden/unit tests. Read traps doc 62cd44cd first. Note dup-keys is ALREADY covered by the queryfacts parse-boundary landing — verify, don't re-fix. MUST land before P3 gates (the inversion's parity depends on parse fidelity).

ops.text: each of the 7 items reproduced against Python, mirrored, and pinned by a parse-level test
cargo test --workspace + full pytest + parse_corpus bench within ≤2% of baseline
landed on main before P3 begins
